summary: Assistant UX round from owner feedback: docking the panel no longer jumps the PDF back to page 1 (layoutPages preserves and restores the current page); suggested questions are now regenerated from the model's per-answer followups; the paper title is shown prominently; the selection becomes a removable 'citation' chip above the input instead of stuffed context text; translation moved out of the assistant into its own popover; and selection accuracy is fixed by adopting pdf.js's own textLayer class and CSS contract, with ✕/Escape to cancel a selection.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit e691baa. UI + QA response contract; two real paper_qa calls to verify followups.

budget_impact.rationale: The paper_qa prompt now requests JSON with followups; the operation and its ceiling are unchanged. Two verification calls were made and ledgered in .local/app/usage.jsonl.
budget_impact.before: QA returned an answer only and the chips were static.
budget_impact.after: QA returns answer + up to three context-aware followups; no budget or provider change.

additional_checks.scope: Two calls returned three context-specific followups each

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; UI/UX work, not recommendation quality

open_risks: Selection accuracy follows the standard pdf.js contract but is still not visually verified by the agent.
Followups depend on the model honouring the JSON contract; otherwise the previous chips remain.
Recommendation quality remains unproven; gates stay not_run.
